name: semantic-crosscheck
description: Cross-layer verification for an ontology plus semantic layer on PostgreSQL 17, for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Prove that a PostgreSQL closure, SHACL rules, OWL reasoning and a Cube model agree.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.21.0 adds explicitly configured contract/plan preflight evidence to report freshness, an optional offline PostgreSQL17 AST structural diagnostic, and independent synthetic bag/DISTINCT/EXCEPT fixtures. Without the paired semantic_preflight section existing report authority is retained. Missing, changed, mismatched or non-passing preflight evidence cannot satisfy the selected report gate. SQL structure diagnostics use separately installed pinned pglast and never connect to a DB or join report authority. Unsupported SQL and missing parser cannot pass. Formal provenance sources inform original small fixtures; no Lean/ProvSQL runtime is bundled. Matching definitions/SQL structures are not business truth or query-equivalence proof. Reviewed is not authenticated approval, and no shared Gold/Cube MVCC snapshot is added. Rerun operational stages after upgrading because engine code changed. Publication does not update active installations or company databases.
defaultPrompt: Use semantic-crosscheck to run the synthetic demo end to end.
Use semantic-crosscheck to verify my crosscheck.toml against PostgreSQL and explain what is not proven.
